name: PT Bhineka Inovasi Ketahanan Energi Tbk
summary: PT Sepeda Bersama Indonesia Tbk primarily operates within the wholesale bicycle trade. This Indonesian entity not only owns the Genio Bike brand but also handles the distribution of United Bike and Avand bicycles. Its market presence is substantial, supported by a broad network of 319 stores. Established in 2017, the company maintains its corporate base in South Tangerang, Indonesia.
